entries.reason: Registered supporting document. Review for package context and relevant routing information without assuming data coverage or authority to change permissions.

Registered proposal, restricted to supplied extracted text. It supplies objectives, definitions and restrictions rather than observed-data coverage; its descriptions do not authorize access to withheld human evidence.

Candidate digitized group-mean plasma time-course input for source-level preparation and later PK input assessment. Preserve day-2 oral dosing, sampling-time and summary-definition conflicts, digitization uncertainty and missing-marker semantics; do not construct individual animals or interpret unresolved zeros as confirmed absence.

Candidate source-reported PK summaries and plasma-binding metadata. Retain dose-specific day-2 context, printed units and conflicting binding descriptions; published parameters are not individual concentration observations, and free-exposure applicability remains unresolved.

Metadata identify published survival-analysis results rather than transcribed regimen-level responses. Retain survival design and isolate-link candidates as reference; published ED50s, exposure indices and conclusions cannot determine primary-analysis initialization, bounds, priors or rankings.

Candidate source-reported single-dose serum PK parameters and binding metadata. Keep bioassay, neutropenia and candidiasis context separate from plasma studies; preserve the half-life discrepancy and detection-limit limitations. Concentration-time observations are not established by this parameter table.

Mixed table may supply strain-matched voriconazole MICs and infection-design metadata. Separate comparator MICs and published ED50/AUC-MIC results before use; the latter remain reference results subject to R012. This label does not establish matched regimen-level CFU response availability or a PD dosing route.

Candidate day-2 intraperitoneal plasma PK summaries. Preserve extrapolated AUC definitions and distinguish imported binding from a study measurement; do not treat parameter summaries as concentration-time observations or transfer them across treatment days.

Published isolate-specific survival ED50s and confidence intervals are reference results, not matched survival observations. Preserve endpoint, treatment duration, follow-up and transcription confidence; prohibit their use for primary-analysis initialization, bounds, priors or rankings.

Candidate group-summary serum concentrations under grapefruit-juice exposure. Retain this distinct biological condition and separate midtreatment, post-treatment and regimen-specific time-since-dose contexts. Do not infer an untreated metabolic condition or a complete PK curve.

Candidate source-reported systemic PK summaries for separate single-dose IV and oral conditions. Separate with-tofacitinib columns from voriconazole-alone columns and preserve sample-size, bioavailability-definition and significance-annotation discrepancies; co-medicated results cannot silently represent untreated animals.

Candidate published population-model parameters, uncertainty and design metadata for saturable elimination and autoinduction. Keep fitted parameters and reported variability distinct from observations. The design includes escalating regimens, so review must identify human-target dependencies before any translation use; no withheld human evidence is authorized.

Visible animal schedule and model-predicted AUC12 values are reference context for identifying the human-target-designed escalating regimen. They are not observations and cannot tune scaling. The removed human-target column and value remain unavailable until authorized task-5 release.

Candidate published systemic model, binding and variability metadata. Preserve healthy versus meningitis groups, per-animal parameter units and fixed-parameter provenance. Separate free brain measurements from the systemic plasma objective and route relevant brain content without treating it as plasma evidence.

Potential plasma exposure summaries occur alongside free-brain results, but matrix-to-group assignment is explicitly unverified. Review may assess definitions and provenance; no value may be accepted as a particular group's plasma AUC until its assignment is supported. Route brain-specific content separately.

Secondary multi-species evidence is restricted to low-confidence context or an explicitly documented sensitivity use, never the sole basis of a species model. Preserve unverified provenance, species/sex mapping, sample sizes and undefined quantities; this label does not resolve MI001 or MI002.

Candidate study-isolate voriconazole MICs for matched aspergillosis PD assessment. Keep comparator columns distinct. Linked EUCAST distribution notes are a separate source and use case; they neither replace isolate MICs nor establish the ownership or coverage of unassigned distribution cells.

Candidate study-isolate voriconazole MICs with separate EUCAST and CLSI methods and modal triplicate summaries. Preserve method-specific values and single-reading provenance. Linked population-distribution notes remain separately scoped and cannot establish matched isolate exposures or authorize unassigned cells.

Explicitly unassigned cells require an authorized table plan before body review. Nearby distribution notes provide a potential MIC-distribution match, not permission, table boundaries or confirmed content.
